name: garmin-mcp-cli
stderr:
Usage: garmin [options] [command]

Garmin Connect MCP: login, sync to a local SQLite cache, previews and
diagnostics

Options:
  -V, --version                           output the version number
  --data-dir <dir>                        data directory (default ~/.garmin-mcp, env GARMIN_DATA_DIR)
  --region <region>                       Garmin region (choices: "global", "cn")
  --log-level <level>                     log level on stderr (default warn)
  -h, --help                              display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                         sign in to Garmin Connect; by default in Garmin's own page in your browser (the password never reaches this tool)
  import-tokens <file>                    import tokens written by python-garminconnect 0.3.x (garmin_tokens.json or its directory)
  logout                                  delete stored tokens (the local database is kept)
  status [options]                        token, database and last sync status
  sync [options]                          download from Garmin into the local database: any scope and date range, only on request; stored days are skipped
  activities [options]                    preview activities from the local database (no network)
  health [options] <metric>               preview a daily metric from the local database (steps, resting_hr, hrv, sleep, stress, body_battery, respiration, spo2, intensity_minutes, calories, floors)
  load [options]                          own training load model from the local database: TSS from power, pace, HR or RPE, CTL/ATL/TSB, ACWR, monotony, weeks, intensity (no network)
  readiness [options] [date]              morning GO / MODIFY / REST decision from HRV, resting HR, sleep hours and load, with Garmin's scores shown (no network)
  thresholds                              threshold history (LTHR, LT1, HRmax, FTP ...): list, add, export and import as CSV
  import-activities [options] <files...>  import Garmin Connect "Activities" CSV exports for dates the synced activities do not cover
  doctor                                  check TLS strategies, hosts, file permissions, tokens and the database driver
  serve [options]                         run the MCP server (same as garmin-mcp-server)
  record [options] <endpoint>             save an anonymized live response as a test fixture (38 endpoints; "list" shows them)
  help [command]                          display help for command
